gemini.title: BGS Geology 625K - Bedrock
gemini.abstract: Generalised 1:625,000-scale bedrock geology polygons for Great Britain. Features identify the mapped lithostratigraphic unit, rock classification and oldest-to-youngest geological age range.
gemini.lineage: Published by British Geological Survey as part of BGS geological data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: lex
columns.description: BGS Lexicon code — short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the named lithostratigraphic or lithodemic unit.

columns.name: lex_d
columns.description: Lexicon description — full name of the lithostratigraphic or lithodemic unit corresponding to the lex code.

columns.name: lex_rcs
columns.description: Combined lexicon and Rock Classification Scheme code linking the named unit to its rock type.

columns.name: rcs
columns.description: Rock Classification Scheme code — short code for the lithological rock type.

columns.name: rcs_x
columns.description: Expanded Rock Classification Scheme expression describing one or more rock types present in the unit.

columns.name: rcs_d
columns.description: Rock Classification Scheme description — full plain-English description of the rock type.

columns.name: rank
columns.description: Geological unit rank such as formation, group, member, intrusion or supergroup.

columns.name: bed_eq
columns.description: Bed-level equivalent code for the geological unit.

columns.name: bed_eq_d
columns.description: Bed-level equivalent description.

columns.name: mb_eq
columns.description: Member-level equivalent code.

columns.name: mb_eq_d
columns.description: Member-level equivalent description.

columns.name: fm_eq
columns.description: Formation-level equivalent code.

columns.name: fm_eq_d
columns.description: Formation-level equivalent description.

columns.name: subgp_eq
columns.description: Subgroup-level equivalent code.

columns.name: subgp_eq_d
columns.description: Subgroup-level equivalent description.

columns.name: gp_eq
columns.description: Group-level equivalent code.

columns.name: gp_eq_d
columns.description: Group-level equivalent description.

columns.name: supgp_eq
columns.description: Supergroup-level equivalent code.

columns.name: supgp_eq_d
columns.description: Supergroup-level equivalent description.

columns.name: max_time_d
columns.description: Maximum (oldest) geological time period label for the unit.

columns.name: min_time_d
columns.description: Minimum (youngest) geological time period label for the unit.

columns.name: max_time_y
columns.description: Maximum age in years before present.

columns.name: min_time_y
columns.description: Minimum age in years before present.

columns.name: max_index
columns.description: BGS numerical index for the older time boundary.

columns.name: min_index
columns.description: BGS numerical index for the younger time boundary.

columns.name: max_age
columns.description: Oldest chronostratigraphic age assigned to the geological unit.

columns.name: min_age
columns.description: Youngest chronostratigraphic age assigned to the geological unit.

columns.name: max_epoch
columns.description: Oldest geological epoch assigned to the unit.

columns.name: min_epoch
columns.description: Youngest geological epoch assigned to the unit.

columns.name: max_subper
columns.description: Oldest geological subperiod assigned to the unit.

columns.name: min_ubper

columns.name: maax_period

columns.name: min_period
columns.description: Youngest geological period assigned to the unit.

columns.name: max_era
columns.description: Oldest geological era assigned to the unit.

columns.name: min_era
columns.description: Youngest geological era assigned to the unit.

columns.name: max_eon
columns.description: Oldest geological eon assigned to the unit.

columns.name: min_eon
columns.description: Youngest geological eon assigned to the unit.

columns.name: prev_name
columns.description: Name associated with the represented feature.

columns.name: bgstype
columns.description: BGS code identifying the geological dataset or layer type, such as 625k_BEDROCK.

columns.name: lex_rcs_i
columns.description: Internal composite identifier combining BGS lexicon and rock-classification references.

columns.name: lex_rcs_d
columns.description: Human-readable description associated with the corresponding coded attribute.

columns.name: map_code
columns.description: Code assigned by the source dataset.

columns.name: age_onegl
columns.description: Generalised geological age label used for map display and broad classification.

columns.name: bgsref
columns.description: Internal BGS reference number for the mapped geological feature.

columns.name: bgsref_lex
columns.description: Internal BGS reference number for the associated lexicon unit.

columns.name: bgsref_fm
columns.description: Internal BGS reference number for the associated formation.

columns.name: bgsref_gp
columns.description: Internal BGS reference number for the associated geological group.

columns.name: bgsref_rk

columns.name: sheet

columns.name: nom_scale

columns.name: nom_os_yr
columns.description: Nominal year or edition of the Ordnance Survey base mapping.

columns.name: nom_bgs_yr
columns.description: Nominal year of the BGS geological compilation.

columns.name: mslink
columns.description: Internal source-system link identifier used by the original mapping database.

columns.name: 625bg_pk
columns.description: Primary-key value for a 1:625,000 bedrock geology feature.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
